description: Returns the payment instructions (the unpaid HTTP 402) for the $1 verified brief; this tool never runs the brief or pays. To get the brief, pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2 (USDC or EURC on Base only) at GET https://horizonpulse.dev/api/research/report/brief?q=... Verified brief, three question types only: Base or Ethereum gas (on-chain read), USDC supply on Ethereum and Base (on-chain totalSupply), or an x402 spec fact. Charged only if at least 2 claims are confirmed in two sources as defined by the contract (two independent nodes, or two separate specification documents); otherwise a 422, unpaid. Contract: https://horizonpulse.dev/contracts/brief-verified. Terms: https://horizonpulse.dev/premium-terms.

q.description: Question about Base or Ethereum gas, USDC supply on Ethereum and Base, or an x402 spec fact. No personal data.

type.description: Optional: skip phrase matching and use this question type.
